summary:
Proposed companion to ADR0001 for Game#810, not an accepted or shipped contract. ClientEffect uses the existing guest Local path. Selection, highlights and plans stay client-only beside authoritative and marked predicted state. Drafts commit and link via game-owned planOf, survive rebind/backend changes and follow settlement. Version1 default codec is game-overridable, little-endian Q24.8; a circle radius must stay positive after quantisation. Proposed pass order is amplifiers, bodies, plans, brackets, cues; future five plan aliases follow the current theme surface. The experimental ReferenceGame proof uses a synchronous F# guest stand-in outside packed libraries, not actual WASM execution; its reducer stores highlights but its plan pass currently does not draw them.

Supplier source constrains the next integration. InputPipeline's proposed settlement accessor reads retained ledger entries only: open and applied-ahead-of-authority commands remain; pruned failures still arrive through io.fail, and None alone is not an outcome. InteractiveScene was already a public record with one Selected field at the cited v0.19.0 source; adding a selected-set field is breaking. Group ARIA and announcements therefore propose a separate opaque presentation payload and additive host route, or an explicitly scheduled major. The cited #797 InputHost has no polite status transport, so the proof owns its own live region. GlyphSpec readers need distinct names familyOf/anchorOf/footprintOf/identityOf/iconOf/teamOf because identity/icon/team already name builders; option readers preserve stored optionality and existing GlyphFamily.name/IconRef.name provide wire names. Keep the PlanView-to-Glyph factory in ClientPresentation after Glyphs, with an additive generic plan-node drawing constructor: putting a PlanView dependency in Glyphs would cycle with ClientEffect's GlyphSpec ghost.

The owning design records these proposals, fallbacks and implementation sequence. Input, glyph and theme owners still control acceptance. Reconcile suppliers in their existing PRs before replaying the proof; source readings and focused proof results establish neither merged-stack compatibility nor production/consumer adoption.
title: Proposed guest-local selection and planning presentation contract
